document_summary: Text of California Civil Code section 1950.6 (via a public.law mirror) governing rental application screening fees, covering California statewide.

rules.title: California application screening fee cap (Civ. Code § 1950.6)
rules.requirement: Landlords may charge an application screening fee no greater than actual out-of-pocket costs plus the reasonable value of time spent, and never more than $30 per applicant, adjustable annually for CPI changes from January 1, 1998. Fees may not be charged when no unit is available, and a receipt itemizing costs must be provided; unused amounts must be returned.
rules.key_value: $30 per applicant cap, CPI-adjustable annually (beginning Jan. 1, 1998); limited to actual costs
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to any landlord (owner of residential rental property) or agent charging an applicant (including a guarantor or cosignor) a screening fee for residential rental housing.
rules.exemptions: Section does not preempt provisions or regulations governing deposits and fees under federal or state housing assistance programs (subd. (l)). Landlords may accept a reusable screening report under Civ. Code § 1950.1.
rules.interaction: Applies notwithstanding Civ. Code § 1950.5 (security deposits); the screening fee is not 'security' under § 1950.5. No local rules addressed in this document.
rules.quoted_span: In no case shall the amount of the application screening fee charged by the landlord or their agent be greater than thirty dollars ($30) per applicant.
rules.conflict_note: Open question: the CPI-adjusted dollar figure for 2026 has no single official published number; this document gives only the statutory $30 base with CPI adjustment and no 2026 adjusted figure.
rules.extraction_notes: Secondary source (public.law mirror), 'updated Jan. 1, 2026'. The CPI adjustment applies beginning January 1, 1998 and is not a new effective date for the cap. Effective date of the current text not stated in the document, so null. Procedural duties (order of consideration, 7-day refunds, receipt, copy of credit report) folded into requirement.
